description: A finite conjunction formed by padding a list with truth is satisfied exactly when every formula in the list is satisfied.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.realize_finiteConj.{u, v, w, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  [Finite α] {n : ℕ} {M : Type z} [L.Structure M]
  (φ : List (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula L α n)) (a : α → M) (b : Fin n → M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Formula.finiteConj φ) a b ↔
    ∀ ψ ∈ φ, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.Realize ψ a b
